water.description: The classic test case. Bent C2v geometry, O-H 0.9686 A, H-O-H 104.00 deg. Also the 17O NMR reference, which is why the geometry is quoted here to four decimals.

water_dimer.description: Hydrogen-bonded dimer, relaxed at B3LYP/6-31G* by this program: O...O 2.863 A, the bridging H sits 1.907 A from the acceptor O. The reference case for a non-covalent interaction.

hydrogen.description: Two-electron system, exact HF reference point.

methane.description: Tetrahedral sp3 carbon, ideal Td symmetry.

ammonia.description: Pyramidal C3v nitrogen, lone pair on N.

benzene.description: Aromatic D6h ring; textbook delocalised pi system.

ethylene.description: Planar D2h alkene, prototypical pi bond.

acetylene.description: Linear D-inf-h alkyne, sp hybridised carbons.

formaldehyde.description: Polar C=O group, strong n->pi* transition.

acetone.description: Simplest ketone; large dipole along the C=O axis.

phenol.description: Hydroxyl on an aromatic ring; resonance and H-bonding.

pyridine.description: Aromatic N heterocycle; lone pair in the ring plane.

pyrrole.description: Nitrogen heteroaromatic; the N-H contributes to aromaticity.

imidazole.description: Two nitrogens, one pyrrole-like and one pyridine-like; basic.

methanol.description: Simplest alcohol; hydrogen-bond donor and acceptor.

ethanol.description: Two-carbon alcohol with a rotating C-C bond.

acetic_acid.description: Carboxylic acid; strong H-bond dimer former.

glycine.description: Smallest amino acid, studied in its neutral form.

caffeine.description: Purine alkaloid; a classic drug-like molecule for benchmarking.

aspirin.description: Acetylsalicylic acid, a widely studied small drug.

nitrobenzene.description: Strongly electron-withdrawing nitro group on benzene.

aniline.description: Amino group directly conjugated to the ring.

styrene.description: Vinyl benzene; conjugation between ring and alkene.

toluene.description: Methyl benzene; hyperconjugation stabilises the ring.

chloroform.description: Trichloromethane; heavy-atom effect and polar C-Cl bonds.

dichloromethane.description: Common solvent; tetrahedral with two Cl atoms.

tfa.description: Very strong organic acid; CF3 inductive effect.

urea.description: Two amide nitrogens; strong hydrogen-bond network.

histamine.description: Imidazole plus a flexible ethylamine chain.

co2.description: Linear D-inf-h; quadrupole moment but no dipole.

carbon_monoxide.description: Linear diatomic; sigma-donor / pi-acceptor ligand, tiny dipole.

nitrogen.description: Triple bond; a notorious challenge for DFT.

nitric_oxide.description: Open-shell diatomic radical (doublet); odd electron in pi*.

methanethiol.description: Sulfur analogue of methanol; compare polarisability.

hydroxide.description: Anionic system - a good test of charge handling.

nitrate.description: Planar D3h anion with three equivalent N-O bonds.

hydroxyl_radical.description: Singly occupied pi orbital; key atmospheric species.

oxygen.description: Triplet ground state - the famous DFT failure case.

porphine.description: Free-base porphyrin; 26 pi electrons, a demanding DFT target.

ethane.description: The simplest C-C single bond; staggered D3d ground state.

propane.description: Three-carbon alkane; the first member with a distinct conformer.

butane.description: Linear C4H10; anti conformer, the reference for gauche strain.

isobutane.description: Branched C4H10; the textbook isomerisation partner of butane.

pentane.description: Linear C5H12; the middle of the alkane trend.

cyclohexane.description: Chair C6H12, D3d; the standard saturated ring.

butadiene.description: Conjugated diene; the four-electron Huckel test case.

cyclohexene.description: Half-chair ring with one double bond.

thiophene.description: Sulfur heteroaromatic; completes the furan/pyrrole series.

pyrazine.description: Para diazine; two equivalent ring nitrogens.

pyrimidine.description: Meta diazine; the ring in cytosine, thymine and uracil.

hydrogen_fluoride.description: The most polar neutral diatomic; a harsh test of a basis set.

hydrogen_chloride.description: Polar diatomic hydride; compare against HF.

silane.description: Tetrahedral SiH4; the silicon analogue of methane.

borane.description: Trigonal planar BH3; the empty p orbital makes it a Lewis acid.

ammonia_borane.description: Dative N->B bond; a hydrogen-storage material.

methylphosphine.description: Primary phosphine, CH3PH2; the first rung of the P-methyl series.

dimethylphosphine.description: Secondary phosphine, (CH3)2PH; the second rung, and the P-H stretch that distinguishes it from the tertiary phosphine.

methaneselenol.description: Selenol, CH3SeH; the selenium analogue of methanethiol, so the two can be compared directly.
methaneselenol.geometry_source: UFF (RDKit ETKDGv3; MMFF94 has no parameters for this molecule)
